caseno: Civil Petition for Leave to Appeal No. 11 of 2005
lawyer:
Md. Nawab Ali, Advocate-on-Record. ----- For the Petitioners. 
Bivash Chandra Biswas, Advocate-on-Record.  ------ For Respondent Nos. 1-4 
Respondent Nos. 5-24 ----- Not represented.
parties:
Saken Ali Mollah being dead his heirs: Md. Kamaluddin Mollah & another ----- Petitioners.
VS
Ayesha Khatun & others ------ Respondents.
full_judgment: 2. The respondents, as plaintiff, instituted Title Suit No. 895 of 1985 before the Court of Munsif (now Assistant Judge), Rajbari of declaration of title, for khas possession and also for further declaration that the compromise decree passed in Title Suit No. 220 of 1981 is collusive, void, illegal and not binding upon them on the averments that the suit land originally belonged to Shahiduddin Mollah who died leaving behind wife Sonai Bibi and minor son Sekandar Ali, Sonai Bibi sold the suit land to Nurun Nahar, predecessor of the plaintiffs by a registered sale deed dated 17.11.1943; after the death of Nurun Nahar, her husband Asmat Ali Mollah and daughter, plaintiff No. 7, inherited the suit land as her heirs; after the death of Asmat Ali the plaintiff nos. 1-7 have been possessing the suit land as heirs; during his life time, Asmat Ali permitted Mofizuddin, father of the defendant Nos. 2-3, to live in the suit land and after the death of Mofizuddin, the plaintiffs asked defendant Nos. 2-3 to vacate the suit land but defendant Nos. 2 and 3 fraudulently inducted the defendant No. 1 in the suit land who by erecting 2(two) sheds and by denying the title of the plaintiffs started living in the suit land; thereafter the plaintiff came to know that the suit and has been wrongly recorded in the name of one Abdul Gani who has/had no title or possession over the suit land and hence the suit. The defendants, the petitioners herein, contested the above suit by filing written statement contending that the suit land originally belonged to Mahabuddin and others and one Shahiduddin possessed the lands with their permission; thereafter the name of Shahiduddin has been recorded in the P.S. Khatian No. 223 as a resident occupant tenant; Shahiduddin had no tenancy right in the suit land so after has death, his wife Sonai Bibi and son Sekandar got no right to the suit land; Mahtabuddin sold out 1.55 acres of land including the suit land to defendant Nos.1 and 2, who are brothers, by a registered deed of sale dated 19.1.44; thereafter the suit land was put into auction for arrears rent in Rent Suit No. 192 of 1946 and Abdul Gani Sardar, a relation of defendant No.1, purchased the suit land then he inducted the defendant No.1 into possession of the suit land as a bargader; the suit land has been rightly recorded in the name of Abdul Gani Sardar in S.A. Khatian; Mafizuddin the father of defendant No.2-3 was permitted to live in the suit land by Abdul Gani Sardar; after the death of Mofizuddin Abdul Gani Sarder sold the suit land to defendant No.1 by a Registered kabala dated 29.1.76 and after his purchase the defendant No.1 asked the defendant Nos. 2-3 to vacate the suit land and on their refusal filed Title Suit No. 220 of 1981 of khas possession; the above suit was decreed on compromise against the defendant Nos. 2-3; since then defendant No.1, by mutating his name, was living in the suit land with his family.
